scenario: Three `FLOAT_LIT` spellings (LLEX.11.2) compile in `where` comparisons: `0.1`, the bare-exponent `1e-6` (LLEX.11.2.2: the exponent is required on the form with no point), and the 16-digit `3.141592653589793`. PINS ONLY THAT THEY LEX AND COMPILE: no baked value is read, so LUNI.2.7.1's cross-host baking is not observed. Named for the LUNI.2.7 heading.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    temp: Float key

rule alpha:
    Sensor s where s.temp > 0.1
->
    log info "a"

rule beta:
    Sensor s where s.temp > 1e-6
->
    log info "b"

rule gamma:
    Sensor s where s.temp > 3.141592653589793
->
    log info "g"
